T-D.method: first training batch of the arm, inside the loop: allocated before forward (A0), after forward (A1: activations and attention kept for backward), after backward (A2: + gradients, - freed activations), after the first AdamW step (A3: + optimiser states); peak = torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated over that batch after a reset; attention = bytes of the outputs of the decoder's multihead attention returned to the caller (forward hook; T-D only); its internal buffers kept for backward are inside A1 - A0 and are not separable from the other activations by this method

T-Z.method: first training batch of the arm, inside the loop: allocated before forward (A0), after forward (A1: activations and attention kept for backward), after backward (A2: + gradients, - freed activations), after the first AdamW step (A3: + optimiser states); peak = torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated over that batch after a reset; attention = bytes of the outputs of the decoder's multihead attention returned to the caller (forward hook; T-D only); its internal buffers kept for backward are inside A1 - A0 and are not separable from the other activations by this method

ram_note: ru_maxrss of the process (Linux: KiB), divided by 1e6: GB to 2.4 %
resumption: none inside a run: checkpoints are written atomically at each best epoch; a lost session is rerun from zero in a new output folder (the optimiser state is not saved, so a resumed run would not be the same run)
